prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing or kneeling as described.

Subject: Russian woman, an adult, in her late 20s, demure and soft expression, warm radiant skin tone, extraordinarily large pregnant physique far beyond any real person — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, carrying a full-term pregnancy, her hips and rear so wide. A high, smoothly rounded pregnant belly projects forward prominently from her front, while behind it a rear so massively rounded and projecting dominates from every angle — the rear itself curving outward and upward in a high, rounded, gravity-defying shape, echoing the belly's own roundness from the opposite side. A full round bust above the belly, gigantic thick thighs. Her head looks small on top of her body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. Her face is a real living adult face, very fair, cool skin, sculpted feathered dark brows, a precise winged liner, soft taupe eyeshadow, long lashes, large pale eyes with bright real catchlights, strong contour and a bright highlighter along the cheekbones and nose bridge, glossy nude-pink lips, a cold, striking expression, vivid copper-orange hair styled in a layered wolf cut with curtain bangs, real pores, real living eyes, 150 clicker rings piercings set with opals in rose-gold-toned metal, wearing a single piece of platinum a necklace. Full body fused with 3 different materials instead of ordinary skin below the collarbones, each material claiming its own region of her figure, covering every inch from neck to ankle without exception, the materials reading as one continuous second skin with no gaps. Her figure is divided into 3 wedge-shaped regions radiating from a single centre point located about 51% of the way down her figure from the top on the centre line of her figure. 3 hazy ray-shaped transition zones leave that centre pointing toward 4 o'clock, 8 o'clock and 10 o'clock as seen by the camera, where 12 o'clock points straight up. Region 1 is the wedge between the 4 o'clock ray and the 8 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries applied ELECTRIC VIOLET leaf, thin irregular metallic sheets laid onto the contour of her body with fine natural creases and overlapping seams, VIVID CYAN undertone glinting through the thinnest points. Region 2 is the wedge between the 8 o'clock ray and the 10 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries pale golden oak wood fused directly into her own form, natural straight grain lines flowing to follow every curve, BLAZING warm honey-blonde grain with VIVID amber highlight streaks. Region 3 is the wedge between the 10 o'clock ray and the 4 o'clock ray, sweeping clockwise: it carries polished obsidian stone fused directly to her own form, solid glossy black stone curving to follow her body's true shape, with molten gold seams running between fitted stone sections. Where two regions meet, the materials interlock naturally: elements of one reach into the other and the two materials simply touch, so the boundary is made only of the two neighbouring materials, each in its own colours, with no gap between them. Each transition zone follows a gently undulating wave, rising and falling softly, rather than a straight course. The materials of every region curve fully around her belly like contour lines circling a globe, the rounded surface of her belly staying fully covered as part of whichever region it falls in, with the same density continuing in full strength over her bust, nowhere on her body left bare, no fabric no seam no garment anywhere. Pose: kneeling on both knees facing the camera directly, both hands resting lightly atop the dome of her belly, serene direct eye contact, her whole silhouette filling the frame from head to her extreme platform thigh-skimming boots, the platform soles rising far higher than her ankle bone.

Background: a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in frame. Lighting: a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus head to toe, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph not an illustration not CGI not a render. Pattern density maximum, zero bare skin from neck to ankle. 2:3 vertical 8K portrait, taller than it is wide.
